name: Dambou
subtitle: Dambou is a couscous with moringa leaves, here made from fine durum wheat semolina mixed with moringa leaves or spinach.

facts.label: Main ingredients
facts.value: Fine durum wheat semolina with spinach or moringa leaves

facts.label: How it is cooked
facts.value: The semolina is steamed in a cloth in the couscous steamer for 20 minutes, loosened, then steamed again for 20 minutes

facts.label: Assembly
facts.value: The cooked semolina is mixed with the greens in a large dish

facts.label: How it is eaten
facts.value: Served as a side to meat, or on its own

parts.text: Dambou is a couscous with moringa leaves, here made from fine durum wheat semolina mixed with moringa leaves or spinach. The semolina is steamed twice in a cloth in the couscous steamer, then mixed with the greens in a large dish.
It is served as a side to meat or eaten on its own.
